##### Project general facts

Helvetia Verde presents a refined residential concept where contemporary design meets a sense of privacy and exclusivity. The development comprises a limited collection of just 108 residences, offering thoughtfully planned 1, 2, and 3.5-bedroom apartments. Its architectural approach is defined by clean lines, balanced proportions, and a modern aesthetic that emphasizes both functionality and elegance, creating a calm and sophisticated living environment within a dynamic urban setting.

The project is complemented by a well-curated selection of amenities designed to support an active and balanced lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, indoor and outdoor fitness areas, and a jogging track, along with dedicated spaces for yoga and meditation. Landscaped gardens, picnic areas, and a children’s playground create a welcoming, family-friendly atmosphere, while retail outlets, a concierge lobby, and 24-hour security add convenience and peace of mind to everyday living.

Interiors at Helvetia Verde reflect a commitment to quality and contemporary comfort. Residences feature premium materials and finishes sourced from Europe, combined with smart layouts and refined detailing to enhance both style and practicality. Kitchens come fully equipped, while the overall design focuses on clean aesthetics and durable materials. The apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their spaces while enjoying a high standard of finishing throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan City is an extraordinary community situated in the heart of Dubai, known for its blend of luxury, sophistication, and world-class amenities. Spanning over a vast area, Meydan City offers a unique living experience that combines urban convenience with a tranquil and scenic environment.

One of the standout features of Meydan City is its iconic Meydan Racecourse, which hosts renowned horse racing events, including the prestigious Dubai World Cup. The racecourse creates an aura of excitement and elegance, attracting enthusiasts from around the world. Residents of Meydan City have the privilege of witnessing the thrilling races firsthand and immersing themselves in the vibrant atmosphere that surrounds this prestigious venue.

Green spaces are integral to the design of Meydan City, with expansive parks, landscaped gardens, and tree-lined boulevards adorning the community. Residents can enjoy leisurely walks, bike rides, or picnics in these serene surroundings, offering a refreshing escape from the bustling city life. The abundance of open spaces also provides opportunities for outdoor activities and social gatherings, fostering a sense of community and well-being.
